card.name: The word on after go or take
card.fires_on: The word "on" (rarely "an") right after a verb like go, going, take or takes us, where an outing or journey noun comes next, such as a hike, trip, vacation or quest.

card.plain: It fires on the little word "on" in phrases like "go on a hike" or "take the kids on trips", where an outing is about to be named.
